description_en: Submits a source workflow read task for a Skill internal operation and returns an asynchronous execution credential. Query the result by calling GetInnerReadAsyncResult
description_zh: Skill 内部接口，提交源端工作流读取任务并返回异步执行凭据，结果通过 GetInnerReadAsyncResult 查询
kebab_example: aliyun lhm post-inner-reader --data-source-descriptor dsName=test_ds318_hangzhou_0428 --data-source-name ds_dolphin_prod --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PostInnerReader

fields.help_en: The data source name. Exact match and fuzzy match are supported
fields.help_zh: 数据源名称，支持精确匹配或模糊匹配
fields.name: ds_name

parameters.help_en: The fallback description used when the data source is missing. Use this parameter to pass the complete data source description information in the request parameters (Plan B)
parameters.help_zh: 数据源缺失时的兜底描述，用于在入参中一次传齐数据源描述信息（方案 B）
parameters.name: data_source_descriptor

parameters.help_en: The data source name. The discovery task uses this field as the dimension identifier
parameters.help_zh: 数据源名称。探查任务以该字段为维度标识
parameters.name: data_source_name

data.description_en: The business data returned by the operation (in string format). The specific content varies by operation
data.description_zh: 接口返回的业务数据（字符串形式），具体内容随接口而异

errCode.description_en: The error code. This value is an empty string if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. This value is an empty string if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which uniquely identifies this call. Provide this value when troubleshooting issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于唯一标识本次调用；排查问题时请提供该值

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed. Troubleshoot by using errCode and errMessage
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
